---
title: "Course Dashboard"
---

```{=html}
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>

<style>
  .auth-warning {
    background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
    border: 1px dashed white;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    margin-top: 10px;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    display: none;
  }
</style>

<div class="global-progress-banner">
  <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-start mb-2 flex-wrap gap-2">
    <div>
      <h2 id="gp-headline" style="margin-bottom: 2px; font-weight: 800;">Your Progress</h2>
      <div id="gp-subtext" style="opacity:0.85;font-size:0.95rem;">Loading…</div>
    </div>
    <div id="auth-status"></div>
  </div>

  <div id="guest-warning" class="auth-warning">
    ⚠️ <strong>Note:</strong> You are not logged in. Progress is only saved locally on this device and may be lost.
  </div>

  <div class="d-flex align-items-center gap-3 mt-3">
    <div class="progress" style="height:22px; flex-grow: 1; background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);">
      <div id="global-progress-bar" class="progress-bar" role="progressbar"
           style="width:0%;background-color:#a8d5a2;color:#1a4d1a;font-weight:900;border-radius:50px;"></div>
    </div>
    <div style="font-size:2.4rem;font-weight:900;opacity:0.9; line-height: 1;" id="gp-percent-badge">0%</div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Leaderboard Bereich (Nur für eingeloggte User) -->
<div id="leaderboard-section" style="display:none;">
  <div class="leaderboard-container">
    <h4 style="font-weight:800; margin-bottom:10px;">🏆 Class Leaderboard</h4>
    <div id="leaderboard-list">Loading rankings...</div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- Nickname Overlay (Erscheint nur, wenn Nickname fehlt) -->
<div id="nickname-overlay" style="display:none; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; width:100%; height:100%; background:rgba(0,0,0,0.8); z-index:9999; align-items:center; justify-content:center;">
  <div style="background:white; padding:30px; border-radius:15px; text-align:center; max-width:400px;">
    <h3 style="color:#1a4d1a;">Welcome!</h3>
    <p style="color:#666;">Please choose a nickname for the leaderboard:</p>
    <input type="text" id="nickname-input" placeholder="CoolDataScientist" 
           style="width:100%; padding:10px; border-radius:50px; border:1px solid #ccc; margin-bottom:15px;">
    <button onclick="saveNickname()" class="btn" style="background:#1a4d1a; color:white; border-radius:50px; padding:10px 30px; font-weight:800;">START LEARNING</button>
  </div>
</div>
<h3 style="color:#1a4d1a;font-weight:800;margin-bottom:1.2rem;margin-top:2rem;">Course Content</h3>
<div class="grid" id="week-cards-grid" style="align-items: stretch;"></div>

<script>
const SUPABASE_URL = 'https://hpyezixseggwnrpepbhx.supabase.co';
const SUPABASE_KEY = 'eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6ImhweWV6aXhzZWdnd25ycGVwYmh4Iiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3NzY4MTUzMDgsImV4cCI6MjA5MjM5MTMwOH0.HGcrv7-I07yFES2qBRhXf1j3UCbfMb8PwlWkQjY6NYs';

let sbClient;
let _initialized = false;

async function initSupabase() {
  if (typeof supabase === 'undefined') {
    setTimeout(initSupabase, 100);
    return;
  }
  
  try {
    if (!_initialized) {
      sbClient = supabase.createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_KEY, {
        auth: { persistSession: true, detectSessionInUrl: true }
      });
      _initialized = true;

      sbClient.auth.onAuthStateChange(async (event, session) => {
        console.log("Auth Event:", event);
        if (session) sessionStorage.setItem('sb-session', JSON.stringify(session));
        else sessionStorage.removeItem('sb-session');
        render(); // UI aktualisieren
      });
    }

    // Erster Versuch zu rendern
    await render();
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Initialization failed:", e);
    // Notfall-Render, damit wenigstens der Guest-Mode geht
    render(); 
  }
}

// Sofort starten
initSupabase();

// Die WEEKS-Definition bleibt gleich...
const WEEKS = [
  { n:1, title:"Week 1: Basic Data Structures", topics:"Syntax · Variables · Vectors · Matrices · Lists · Dataframes", href:"1_datentypen.html", chunkCount:28, quizIds:["w1_q_vectors","w1_q_matrices","w1_q_lists","w1_q_dataframes"] },
  // ... (Rest der Liste)
];

function getLang() {
  try { return localStorage.getItem('da_course_lang') || 'python'; } catch(e) { return 'python'; }
}

let _isRendering = false;

async function render() {
  if (_isRendering) return;
  _isRendering = true;

  try {
    const grid = document.getElementById('week-cards-grid');
    if (!grid) return;

    let user = null;
    let dbData = null;

    // SICHERHEITS-CHECK: Nur wenn sbClient da ist, versuchen User zu holen
    if (sbClient) {
      const { data } = await sbClient.auth.getSession();
      user = data?.session?.user || null;

      if (user) {
        const { data: rows } = await sbClient
          .from('progress')
          .select('key, value')
          .eq('id', user.id);
        
        if (rows) {
          dbData = {};
          rows.forEach(r => { dbData[r.key] = (r.value === 'true' || r.value === true); });
        }
      }
    }

    // UI zeichnen
    updateAuthUI(user);
  
    // 1. Transparenz steuern
    const banner = document.querySelector('.global-progress-banner');
    const cards = document.getElementById('week-cards-grid');
    if (!user) {
        banner.classList.add('auth-locked');
        cards.classList.add('auth-locked');
        document.getElementById('leaderboard-section').style.display = 'none';
    } else {
        banner.classList.remove('auth-locked');
        cards.classList.remove('auth-locked');
        document.getElementById('leaderboard-section').style.display = 'block';
        checkNickname(user); // Prüfen, ob Nickname existiert
        loadLeaderboard();   // Leaderboard laden
    }
    
    grid.innerHTML = '';
    let totalAll = 0, doneAll = 0, completedW = 0;
    const activeW = WEEKS.filter(w => !w.locked && w.chunkCount).length;

    WEEKS.forEach(week => {
      const p = calculateWeekProgress(week, dbData);
      if (p) { totalAll += p.total; doneAll += p.done; if (p.pct === 100) completedW++; }

      const col = document.createElement('div');
      col.className = 'g-col-12 g-col-sm-6 g-col-md-4';
      const isLocked = !!week.locked;
      const card = document.createElement(isLocked ? 'div' : 'a');
      card.className = 'week-card p-3' + (isLocked ? ' opacity-50' : '');
      if (!isLocked && week.href) card.href = week.href;
      const pct = p ? p.pct : 0;
      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="week-card-title">${week.title}</div>
        <div class="week-card-topics">${week.topics}</div>
        <div class="week-card-status">${statusLabel(p, isLocked)}</div>
        ${p ? `<div class="week-card-progress-bar-bg mt-2"><div class="week-card-progress-fill" style="width:${pct}%"></div></div><div style="font-size:0.73rem;color:#6c757d;margin-top:4px;">${pct}% complete</div>` : ''}
      `;
      col.appendChild(card);
      grid.appendChild(col);
    });

    const gPct = totalAll > 0 ? Math.round((doneAll / totalAll) * 100) : 0;
    const bar = document.getElementById('global-progress-bar');
    if (bar) { bar.style.width = gPct + '%'; bar.innerText = gPct > 8 ? gPct + '%' : ''; }
    const badge = document.getElementById('gp-percent-badge');
    if (badge) badge.innerText = gPct + '%';
    const sub = document.getElementById('gp-subtext');
    if (sub) sub.innerText = `${completedW} of ${activeW} weeks completed · ${getLang().toUpperCase()} mode`;

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Render error:", err);
  } finally {
    _isRendering = false;
  }
}

function calculateWeekProgress(week, dbData) {
  if (!week.chunkCount) return null;
  const lang = getLang();
  const total = week.chunkCount + (week.quizIds ? week.quizIds.length : 0);
  let done = 0;
  const isDone = id => {
    if (dbData && dbData[id] !== undefined) return dbData[id] === true;
    try { return localStorage.getItem(id) === 'true'; } catch(e) { return false; }
  };
  for (let i = 1; i <= week.chunkCount; i++) if (isDone(`chunk_${lang}_w${week.n}_c${i}`)) done++;
  (week.quizIds || []).forEach(qid => { if (isDone(`quiz_${lang}_w${week.n}_${qid}`)) done++; });
  return { done, total, pct: Math.round((done / total) * 100) };
}

function statusLabel(p, locked) {
  if (locked) return '🔒 Locked';
  if (!p) return '📋 No exercises yet';
  if (p.pct === 100) return '✅ Completed';
  if (p.done > 0) return '🔄 In progress — ' + p.done + '/' + p.total + ' done';
  return '⬜ Not started';
}

function updateAuthUI(user) {
  const container = document.getElementById('auth-status');
  const warning = document.getElementById('guest-warning');
  if (!container) return;
  if (user) {
    warning.style.display = 'none';
    const name = user.user_metadata?.user_name || user.email || 'User';
    container.innerHTML = `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;"><span style="font-size:0.85rem;opacity:0.9;">👋 ${name}</span><button onclick="sbLogout()" class="btn btn-sm" style="background:white;color:#1a4d1a;border:2px solid white;border-radius:50px;font-weight:800;padding:5px 20px;">LOGOUT</button></div>`;
  } else {
    warning.style.display = 'block';
    container.innerHTML = `<button onclick="sbLogin()" class="btn btn-sm" style="background:#1a4d1a;color:white;border:2px solid white;border-radius:50px;font-weight:800;padding:5px 20px;">🐙 LOGIN WITH GITHUB</button>`;
  }
}

async function sbLogin() {
  await sbClient.auth.signInWithOAuth({
    provider: 'github',
    options: { redirectTo: window.location.origin + window.location.pathname }
  });
}

async function sbLogout() {
  await sbClient.auth.signOut();
  sessionStorage.removeItem('sb-session');
  window.location.reload();
}

async function checkNickname(user) {

  const { data, error } = await sbClient.from('profiles').select('nickname').eq('id', user.id).maybeSingle();
  
  if (error) {
    console.error("Error checking nickname:", error);
    return;
  }

  if (!data || !data.nickname) {
    document.getElementById('nickname-overlay').style.display = 'flex';
  } else {
    document.getElementById('nickname-overlay').style.display = 'none';
  }
}

async function saveNickname() {
  const name = document.getElementById('nickname-input').value.trim();
  if (!name) return alert("Please enter a name!");
  
  const { data: { user } } = await sbClient.auth.getUser();
  const { error } = await sbClient.from('profiles').upsert({ id: user.id, nickname: name });
  
  if (error) {
    alert("Nickname already taken or error!");
  } else {
    document.getElementById('nickname-overlay').style.display = 'none';
    render(); // Seite neu laden
  }
}

async function loadLeaderboard() {
  const { data, error } = await sbClient.from('leaderboard').select('*').limit(5);
  const container = document.getElementById('leaderboard-list');
  if (error || !data) return;

  container.innerHTML = data.map((entry, index) => `
    <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:5px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);">
      <span>${index + 1}. ${entry.nickname}</span>
      <span style="font-weight:800;">${entry.percent}%</span>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}
</script>
```
